alerts.title: EFV neuropsychiatric toxicity
alerts.message: Guidelines state EFV frequently causes neuropsychiatric effects, typically insomnia and vivid dreams, within the first 2-6 weeks of therapy. The patient has been on an EFV-based regimen since February 2024 and presents with poor sleep and vivid dreams for several weeks. This is a persistent central nervous system toxicity. The patient reports no suicidal ideation, which is a common concern requiring assessment. The symptoms are a known adverse event of EFV.

evidence.recommended_action: Assess for suicidality and consider management per guidelines, which may include regimen substitution.

alerts.title: Missing viral load monitoring
alerts.message: The patient's last viral load was 60 copies/mL on 2025-08-10, which is 165 days (over 5 months) before the current visit. Routine viral load monitoring is essential for assessing ART efficacy. The clinician's plan does not include ordering a new viral load test. There is no evidence of a recent result to confirm ongoing viral suppression.

evidence.recommended_action: Order a viral load test as per routine monitoring schedule.
